summary: Custom global generators are implemented. A generator named `Foo` placed at `<cache>/extensions/generators/Foo.py` can be listed by name in `generators` and is loaded from the cache. Changes: `conans/client/cache/cache.py` adds `GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER` and `ClientCache.generators_path`; `conans/client/generators/__init__.py` adds `_get_custom_generator_class()`, makes `_get_generator_class()` fall back to the custom folder after built-ins, and gives `write_generators()` an optional `cache_generators_path` argument; `conans/client/installer.py` and `conan/api/subapi/install.py` pass the cache path through. Built-in generators take priority over custom files, and the file must define a class with the same name as the file. Nothing was run or tested, per the instructions; this was verified by reading only. No tests or docs were added, and nothing was committed.
